method: The production civilian voxel service and combat simulation run together with a deterministic body/umbrella fixture and real matrix raycasts, continuous swept footprints, falling poses, and cooldowns.

results.test: Real voxel body service ignores umbrella, receives60damage shots, settles corpse, and resets alive
Real civilian raycasts cannot shoot through static cover
Real swept footprints kill on forward and reverse passes, miss beyond the body side, and count each death once
Low-speed escape releases an injury contact lock for a later distinct impact
